title: Shared folder, review sync and notifications
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-02 real local notifications, A-11 shared-folder browsing and A-32 shared-folder review with XFDF import/export
notes: Split out of T-0221 round A. Serves A-02 (bell lists real local events only: document saved, export finished, signature request returned later; capped list, popover, honest empty state), A-11 (shared folder configured in settings, lists PDFs and XFDF review files, opens them, no network assumptions) and A-32 (Comment & Review collaborate: XFDF import/export and shared-folder review sync) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. pdfxi-edit already exports export_xfdf/import_xfdf for annotations and has review::ReviewRegistry for a network-free local shared-review file with deterministic merge. The app must surface XFDF import/export in the Comment & Review flow, sync the review registry through the shared folder, show new-comment notifications, and report conflicts rather than silently overwriting. App-lane work serialised behind T-0221.
